tweet.text:
Recently the @SeedifyFund has been rolling out new initiatives that provide more value to the people in their ecosystem 🌱

They're already one of the premiere launchpads, so why are they trying out new programs?

Innovation is key in Web3

Their initiatives are:
➡️AI Jam - IDOs for projects with a $1 million FDV with 75%+ float
➡️Gem Factory - IDOs for low caps
➡️NFT Launchpad
➡️Bringing on more content creators to spread awareness

AI Jam & The Gem Factory are both something I find really interesting 

The goal for Gem Factory is:

"Giving those who chose meme coins due to staling opportunities (that arose from high FDVs and low R/R tokenomics) a reason to come back and support real utility advancements for the growth of Web3"

Seedify realizes where the attention is in the market, and are working to implement ways to capture that attention

I'm interested to see how the initial launches do, and how they continue to roll out new initiatives moving forward
